items.topic: Reader batches: subagents with no output get split; checker rules
items.fact: queue.py record(): reader output validated by check_batch.py; REJECT retried twice, third time batch split in halves (ids suffix a/b); subagent with no output is split immediately via round.py. round.py R1.. -- V1.. records readers+verifies and prints next round; env NREAD (default 23), NVER (default 2). Before re-running an interrupted round, pop 'running' statuses from queue-state.json. Checker rejects evidence line ranges (needs single lines) and entries with no symbols (empty partials need placeholders).

items.topic: Opus validator throughput: 6 batches per validator agent
items.fact: Opus backlog grew to ~100 batches; agent decided to run 21 readers + 4 Opus validators per round, then one validator agent per 6 batches (4 agents = 24 batches/round) since checks almost always pass.

items.topic: Subagent scope: follow the batch file, not the 'src' request
items.fact: Readers C217b/C218b noted the batch prompt defines scope (batch file items), not a general review of src/; the instruction 'read reader-prompt.md with {ID}' governs.

items.topic: Operator 'resume' after interruption
items.fact: After an interrupted round, check which out/<ID>.json exist, pop status for missing ones, then run round.py with the finished ids; unfinished readers get re-queued.
